title: Sentier inventory sector metadata
description: Provenance file (metadata.json) carried by each data/<NN>-<sector>/ folder. Inventory is organised by sector; "sources" lists every datasource id present in this folder's processes.parquet "source" column. The source-to-row import log stays in sentier-importers.

sector.description: Lower-kebab sector / data-type id, e.g. agriculture, electricity, chemicals.

rank.description: Folder ordering / resolution precedence; lower wins.

sources.description: Datasource ids present in this folder's processes.parquet source column, e.g. ["bafu-2026"]. Must equal the column's distinct values (CI-checked).
